name: Agomelatine
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Mainly oxidized by CYP1A2, with smaller CYP2C9/CYP2C19 contributions. Hydroxylated and demethylated metabolites are inactive, rapidly conjugated and eliminated in urine.
